items.title: File lawsuit (Klage) against the order
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated 18.11.2026 and the covering letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); the letter gives no separate postmark date, so 19.11.2026 is taken as the day the notice was given to the postal service. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW, a notice sent by ordinary mail is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after posting: 19.11.2026 + 3 days = 22.11.2026, which is a Sunday. Since the third day falls on a Sunday, the deemed delivery shifts to the next business day (§ 31 Abs. 1 VwVfG i.V.m. § 193 BGB), i.e. Monday, 23.11.2026, which becomes the date of Bekanntgabe. The one-month Klagefrist is an Ereignisfrist (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted, and per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the one-month period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same calendar number as the day of Bekanntgabe, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) date was calculated assuming the postal dispatch date equals the letter's printed date (19.11.2026), as no separate postmark date is given; if the actual posting date differs, the Klagefrist end date would shift accordingly.

The order itself (operating-hours restriction on the wood splitter) takes effect immediately upon notification and has no further calendar deadline beyond the lawsuit deadline, so it was not listed as a separate dated item.
